text:
sam: Heads-up — planning Terraform change to switch GPU fleets to mixed Spot / On‑Demand with launch template + mixed instances. Goal: 30-40% cost reduction. Thinking: mixed instances policy, capacity-optimized allocation, diversified instance types (p4d => p4de + p3dn + g5 as fallbacks). Anyone seen issues with interruptions or AMI boot times for our training/serving pools?

maria: I prototyped a template. Key bits:
```hcl
resource "aws_launch_template" "gpu" {
  name_prefix = "rw-gpu-"
  image_id = var.gpu_ami
  instance_type = ""
  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }
  tag_specifications = [{ resource_type = "instance", tags = { team = "inference", env = var.env } }]
}

resource "aws_spot_fleet_request" "gpu_fleet" {
  iam_fleet_role = aws_iam_role.spot_fleet.arn
  allocation_strategy = "capacity-optimized-prioritized"
  launch_template_config = [{ launch_template_specification = { id = aws_launch_template.gpu.id, version = "$Latest" }, overrides = [{ instance_type = "p4d.24xlarge" }, { instance_type = "p4de.24xlarge" }, { instance_type = "g5.48xlarge" }] }]
}
```
Also set `instance_market_options` in overrides for Spot and tag on fleet request for cost-center.

raj: Two quick flags:
- Interruption handling: short-notice SIGTERM + 2-min termination notice. We need checkpointing for long-running jobs and faster serialization for models (kv-cache flush). For serving, enable graceful drain and fallback routing to on-demand.
- AMI boot cold-start: some of the p4de/g5 instances take extra ~60s due to ENA firmware. We should bake AMIs per instance family and include cloud-init prefetch of docker images.

jess: For k8s pools: use node labels like `node.k8s.redwood/gpu-family=p4` and taints `spot=true:NoSchedule` so critical pods avoid spots unless tolerate. Also add a kured/spot-termination handler + use the AWS interruption notice to cordon/drain quickly.

infra-bot: terraform plan finished for branch feat/spot-mixed (apply pending approval). Changes: +3 resources, mod: aws_launch_template, new: aws_spot_fleet_request, aws_iam_role for spot. CI tests passed: k8s deploy smoke ok.

maria: Rollout plan proposal:
- Stage 1 (canary): small fleet in us-west-2, 10% of new capacity, 1-week soak. Metrics: pod evictions/hour, interruption_count, 99p latency, cost per token/hour.
- Stage 2: 50% capacity, enable instance diversification to include g5.
- Stage 3: full rollout + switch default routing to capacity optimized.

raj: Also add CloudWatch metric filter for `SpotInstanceTermination` and alert if >5/hour in a region. And a runbook: on high eviction rate, temporarily increase on-demand baseline and pause spot autoscaling.

jess: Ops tasks for Terraform:
- Add launch_template versions instead of in-place edits (avoid drift)
- Tag `terraform:managed=true` and `redwood:pool=spot-mixed` for visibility
- Coordinate AMI bake job: packer pipeline must output AMI map keyed by family

sam: OK; next steps:
- Maria to open PR with the TF snippet + versioned LT + tags (target end of day)
- Raj to update interruption handler and add metric dashboard panels
- Jess to add k8s taint/toleration changes and bake AMIs per family
- I'll schedule a canary deploy early next week and post the runbook in #incidents

ops-oncall: +1, will monitor during canary and take paging if eviction > 3/min in any AZ

sam: thanks all :thumbsup: Let's keep notes in the PR and tag me for approval.
